preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the addBots() function with an array containing the victim's address and set _status to true. This will blacklist the victim address, preventing them from making transactions when antibot is enabled. The exploit demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can arbitrarily block any address from transacting.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an addBots() function that is only callable by the owner (onlyOwner modifier). This function allows the owner to add any address to a botlist mapping. When antibot is enabled (default true), the _transfer() function checks if either sender or recipient is in botlist and reverts if true. This gives the owner arbitrary power to block any address from transacting, which is a privilege abuse vulnerability.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call addBots() with the victim's address to add them to the botlist. This will demonstrate that the owner can arbitrarily block any address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call addBots() with an array containing the victim address and status=true. 4. Verify that botlist[victim] is now true.
